change_interpretations.engineering_summary: Adds a strict 80 ms maximum latency timing limit for issuing emergency brake commands, requiring procedure updates and re-execution for tests verifying emergency brake command issuance.

assessments.reason: This test verifies accelerator step response torque timing under VCU-DR-01 (100 ms limit), which is unchanged.
evidence: requirement_reference_raw: VCU-DR-01
procedure: Step validated accelerator demand to 75%; confirm requested positive torque no later than 100 ms
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this change.

assessments.reason: The test verifies brake override priority linked to VCU-BRK-03, but previous evidence did not report timing. The procedure must be updated to measure the 80 ms brake command latency requirement and be re-run.
evidence: requirement_reference_raw: VCU-DR-01; VCU-BRK-03
comment: Timing not reported in old evidence
VCU-BRK-03 new_text: issued within 80 milliseconds of the emergency brake input
assessments.recommended_action: Update test procedure to measure latency against the 80 ms limit and re-run the test.

assessments.reason: This test measures accelerator demand high-load torque transients, which relates to driver torque response rather than emergency brake override.
evidence: procedure: Sweep demand 75–95% at nominal and high-load cases
comment: Legacy suite still checks 95 ms tolerance
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this change.

assessments.reason: The test measures brake command latency under VCU-BRK-03. The previous target of 100 ms and measured result of 88 ms exceed the new 80 ms maximum limit.
evidence: requirement_reference_raw: VCU-BRK-03
previous_result: PASS (88 ms)
procedure: target brake command latency within 100 ms
VCU-BRK-03 new limit: 80 milliseconds
assessments.recommended_action: Update the test procedure latency threshold from 100 ms to 80 ms and re-run the test.

assessments.reason: This test verifies wheel-speed sensor failure degraded mode under unchanged requirement VCU-DGN-04.
evidence: requirement_reference_raw: VCU-DGN-04
procedure: Unplug simulated wheel-speed sensor and confirm degraded mode + fault log
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this change.

assessments.reason: This test verifies logging of mode changes under unchanged requirement VCU-LOG-05.
evidence: requirement_reference_raw: VCU-LOG-05
procedure: Change Comfort to Sport; log timestamp and build identifier
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this change.

assessments.reason: Although the requirement link is TBD, the procedure scope covers pedal acceleration response under thermal load, which is unrelated to emergency brake override.
evidence: procedure: At 80% pedal and elevated load, check that torque delivery is consistent with vehicle response definition
requirement_reference_raw: TBD
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this change.

assessments.reason: This test checks legacy diagnostic trace replay and does not cover emergency brake command functionality.
evidence: procedure: Re-run old diagnostic trace; verify expected non-blocking status
requirement_reference_raw: VCU-OLD-88
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this change.

assessments.reason: This test evaluates drive mode torque profile ramps under unchanged requirement VCU-MOD-06.
evidence: requirement_reference_raw: VCU-MOD-06
procedure: Compare accelerator response under Sport vs Comfort during ramp and release
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this change.

assessments.reason: This test checks pedal signal noise rejection under unchanged requirement VCU-DR-02.
evidence: requirement_reference_raw: VCU-DR-02
procedure: Inject 7 ms false pedal pulse and verify no propagated torque request
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this change.

assessments.reason: The test verifies torque cancellation upon emergency braking linked to VCU-BRK-03. The procedure must be updated to incorporate and verify the new 80 ms latency requirement when braking is commanded.
evidence: requirement_reference_raw: VCU-BRK-03
procedure: While demand is high, request emergency braking and verify positive torque drops according to brake priority
VCU-BRK-03 new_text: issued within 80 milliseconds of the emergency brake input
assessments.recommended_action: Update procedure to include the 80 ms latency criteria and re-run the test.

assessments.reason: This test measures ECU boot and readiness startup time, which is unrelated to brake override.
evidence: procedure: Power cycle the ECU; verify readiness within 500 ms
comment: Platform startup only
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this change.
